entries: 2.1.316: Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
2.1.317: Changed subagents and teammates on a different model from the main conversation to use that model's saved effort level or its default, instead of the session's effort level

subagentReference.observation: A subagent definition's effort overrides the session level but not CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL; a per-call effort parameter applies to non-fork subagents and overrides the definition; without either, a subagent on the main conversation's model runs at the session level. The page does not mention CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT.
